releases.name: Feature release 2.3.0
releases.body: * Support for Qiskit 1.0

releases.name: Feature release 2.2.2
releases.body:
* Support for Qiskit 0.46.0
* Support for python 3.12
* Readthedocs fix

releases.name: Feature release 2.2.1
releases.body:
* Add Qiskit 'reset' gate to circuit parser and translate to prep_z when supported by the backend
*  Qiskit aer installed separately as required
* Cleanup QI-projects from test pipelines

releases.name: Feature release 2.2.0
releases.body:
* [SDS-982] Example for deleting projects added
* [SDS-981] Argument type check added for api `run` method
* [SDS-977] Easier handling async jobs, api method `wait_for_completed_job` made public
* [SDS-NNN] Some pylintrc incompatibilities solved

releases.name: Feature release 2.1.0
releases.body:
* [SDS-826] unused package breaks nightly (#153)
* [SDS-794] Check for raw data list was wrong (#150)
* [SDS-716] Quantum Volume Computation (#147)
* [SDS-617] Fix measurement statements in ProjectQ (#143)
* [SDS-NNN] Some changes/bugs while testing plugin for quantuminspire (#142)
* [SDS-610] Measurement mask field in asset deleted (#141)

releases.name: Feature release 2.0.0
releases.body:
* SDK uses v2.0 of API interface
* Added multiple measurement support
* Barrier/Wait commands added
* Fix for non-lineair measured bits used in conditional
* Fix for serializable status-field in result

releases.name: Feature release 1.7.0
releases.body:
* Rendering of the readthedocs html-documention repaired
* delete_job api fixed. Doesn't return anything
* Fixed nightly build

releases.name: Feature release 1.6.0
releases.body:
* Ability added to get backend status
* Added calibration information to result
* Coupling map fixed
* Unit testing now make use of Qiskit circuits instead of depending on Qiskit internals

releases.name: Feature release 1.5.0
releases.body:
* Get API from Quantum Inspire Provider in Qiskit backend
* Documentation improvements 
* Now able to get calibration data from Quantum Inspire result
* Fix for damaged projects that were left when an error occurred while creating the experiment
* Extra check for having enough classical bits defined
* Split examples from SDK to separate repository https://github.com/QuTech-Delft/quantum-inspire-examples
* Added get_authentication method used in many examples
* Optimized-flag validity check for hardware backends

releases.name: Feature release 1.4.0
releases.body:
* Notebook update for Qiskit Terra 0.17.3
* Read the docs added
* Quantum Inspire project name support for Qiskit projects
* Added SAT example to docs

releases.name: Feature release 1.3.0
releases.body:
* Changes for new Qiskit Terra (0.15.x) in Qiskit 0.20.0
* Supporting hardware-backend configurations
* Updated documentation of the API-structures

releases.name: Feature release 1.2.0
releases.body:
* Support for latest Qiskit and ProjectQ versions
* full_state_projection for API-calls `execute_qasm` and `execute_qasm_async` defaults to False instead of True
* Some minor changes for supporting hardware backends

releases.name: Feature release 1.1.0
releases.body:
* Revised full state projection support
* Added reuse of ancilla bits for ProjectQ
* Support for latest Qiskit version
* Solved a code generation bug in Qiskit backend when using certain values of rotation parameters
* Mybinder now does not show error message "404 Not found" anymore but shows a preview
* Updated distance based classifier example

releases.name: Feature release 1.0.0
releases.body:
* Support for Qiskit version >=0.9.0
* Added distance based classifier example

releases.name: Feature release 0.7.0
releases.body:
* Qiskit support for Qiskit version <0.9.0:
  * Support for binary controlled gates
  * Added support for basis gates S, Sdag, T, Tdag and SWAP
* ProjectQ support:
  * SWAP gate made available
  * Easy `QIBackend` creation with all defaults and saved token
* Support for API token authentication

releases.name: Feature release 0.6.0
releases.body:
* Qiskit support:
  * Add memory feature (raw measurement data)
  * Add access to full-state histogram
  * Fix implementation of u3, u2, u1 and u
  * Generate qiskit counts from memory instead of from histogram
* ProjectQ support:
  * Throw exception when re-using a `QIBackend` engine
  * Eliminate the requirement to use a (trivial) `ManualMapper`
* Expanded in-line documentation of `QuantumInspireAPI` class
* Added type-hints
* Install examples
* Preliminary support for API token authentication

releases.name: Bugfix release 0.5.0
releases.body:
* Project deletion fixed
* Memory-field in result disabled temporarily for the backend
* Rx, Ry and Rz rotation gates available in quantum inspire backend
* Re-use of classical bits allowed

releases.name: Bugfix release 0.4.2
releases.body:
* Fix ProjectQ example notebook
* Change classifier, alpha to beta

releases.name: Update release 0.4.0
releases.body:
* Publish SDK releases to the [Python Package Index](https://pypi.org/) (PyPI)
* Update Qiskit backend to Qiskit 0.7.0 specification
* Update README.md known issues and issue tracker link

releases.name: Fix release 0.3.1
releases.body: * Fix qiskit dependency on pre-0.7.0 temporarily

releases.name: Update release 0.3.0
releases.body:
* [DEM-578] Remove retry limit from QuantumInspireAPI execution method (#7)
* [DEM-579] Asynchronous Jobs (#8)
* [DEM-584] Refactor qiskit backend to BaseProvider/BaseBackend (#9)
* [DEM-695] fix issues with measurement translation in projectq backend (#10)

releases.body: Initial release of the Quantum Inspire API and ProjectQ / Qiskit backends.
